units.Reporting integral en Power BI para una: End-to-end Power BI reporting for a store chain: star schema, Power Query, DAX, disconnected tables and drill-down to the receipt.
units.Cómo construí un sistema de reporting pa: How I built a reporting system for a store chain: from the point-of-sale system to the star schema, from Power Query to DAX, up to a dashboard with drill-down to the receipt.
units.Un sistema de reporting en Power BI: del: A Power BI reporting system: from the point-of-sale system to the star schema, up to a dashboard with drill-down to the receipt.
units.De una alerta en el dashboard al ticket: From an alert on the dashboard to the receipt that explains it
units.Una red de tiendas genera datos constant: A store network generates data all the time. The challenge is turning it into context.
units.Una red de tiendas puede acumular miles: A store network can pile up thousands of receipts and have plenty of data available, but that doesn’t mean the information is easy to use. The sales data already existed: the problem was how to use it.
units.Había información suficiente para conoce: There was enough information to know the results, but no structure that made it easy to analyse what lay behind each change.
units.En este proyecto partí de datos de TPV y: In this project I started from point-of-sale data and built a Power BI reporting system designed to go from an overview of the business to the detail that explains each result. I framed the project around a simple question: what should someone in leadership be able to answer when they notice something has changed?
units.<strong>Mi objetivo era que una desviaci: My aim was for a variance in a KPI not to end in a number, but to be traceable until you find the store, product or receipt behind it. From there I built the model, the measures and the report pages so the analysis could move from the summary down to the detail.
units.De una desviación en un KPI al ticket qu: From a variance in a KPI to the receipt that explains it.
units.Un KPI puede decirme que las ventas han: A KPI can tell me that sales have dropped, but that’s only the start of the analysis. I wanted the report to let you follow that variance and understand where it happens: which store is behind it, which products are driving it and what happened at receipt level.
units.Por eso planteé el reporting con diferen: That’s why I designed the reporting with different levels of detail. The idea is simple: start with a signal and be able to dig down until you find the context that explains it.
units.Una estructura pensada para poder analiz: A structure designed to analyse sales from different angles.
units.Antes de construir los gráficos, necesit: Before building the charts, I needed to put the data in order. The idea was that the same sale could be related to its store, product, date and budget without duplicating information or complicating the analysis.
units.Para ello construí un <strong>esquema en: To do that I built a star schema, a way of organising data that separates the sales and budget information from the data we use to analyse it, such as stores, products or dates.
units.El modelo parte de dos tablas principale: The model starts from two main tables:
units.<code style=\"background:var(--kc-mist);: Ventas → what was sold, when, where and for how much.
Presupuestos → which sales were planned.
units.Y las relacioné con tres tablas que apor: And I related them to three tables that add context:
units.<code style=\"background:var(--kc-mist);: Fecha → day, month, quarter and year.
Productos → product and category.
Tienda → store, location, floor area, employees, rent and population.
units.Vista del modelo de datos de Kosta Cálid: Kosta Cálida’s data model in Power BI Desktop
units.El modelo real, en la vista de relacione: The real model, in Power BI Desktop’s relationship view.
units.Así puedo pasar de una pregunta general,: That way I can move from a general question, such as "how much have we sold?", to more specific ones such as "which store is behind the result?" or "which product is driving it?", without having to rebuild the data for each analysis.
units.Además, añadí algunas tablas auxiliares: I also added some helper tables to control elements of the dashboard, such as the store, product and category selectors and the Top N rankings. These tables don’t contain new sales: they let users interact with the report without changing the main structure of the model.
units.El objetivo no era construir un modelo c: The aim wasn’t to build a complex model for its own sake, but to have an orderly base that makes it possible to ask questions about the business and reach the detail needed to answer them.
units.A medida que el modelo crecía, también l: As the model grew, so did the number of measures needed to analyse it. I reached 92 DAX measures and decided to organise them in a clear structure, grouping the logic so each calculation would be easier to find, maintain and reuse — the way you organise a code project, not a spreadsheet.
units.Deltas, colores hex dinámicos, puntos má: Deltas, dynamic hex colours, max/min points and Top N ranking.
units.No se trataba solo de conseguir que las: It wasn’t just about getting the measures to work. I also wanted to be able to come back to the project after a while and quickly understand where each calculation was and what it did.
units.Del TPV en bruto a un dashboard con dril: From raw point-of-sale data to a dashboard with drill-down.
units.El siguiente paso fue llevar el modelo a: The next step was to take the model into Power BI and build navigation that goes from the general to the specific. I started from the point-of-sale data and built different levels of analysis so users could dig deeper when they found a relevant change. Drill-down became a key part of the report: not just showing the figure, but letting you investigate what lies behind it.
units.Transformar y estandarizar los datos bru: Transforming and standardising the raw point-of-sale data before it reached the model.
units.Dos tablas de hechos y tres dimensiones,: Two fact tables and three dimensions, with five active relationships designed before the first page.
units.Organizadas en carpetas: acumulados, com: Organised into folders: cumulative, previous-period comparisons, profit, budgets, last sale.
units.Localización, Tienda, Categoría/Producto: Location, Store, Category/Product and Special margin: disconnected, for cascading filters without touching the schema.
units.TopN dinámico (Top1 a Top20) para los ra: Dynamic TopN (Top1 to Top20) for the category and product rankings.
units.Portada, ranking, evolución, comparativa: Cover, ranking, trends, comparisons, 6 drill-through pages and 2 custom SVG tooltips.
units.No todas las personas necesitan consulta: Not everyone needs to look at the information in the same way. That’s why I structured the report’s 13 pages around different analysis needs and user profiles. The information changes with the level of detail each person needs, but the model and the analysis logic stay connected. That way the report works as a reporting system, not just a collection of separate dashboards.
units.Objetivos: cumplimiento anual con bullet: Targets: annual performance with a bullet chart, YTD trend, sales by store vs budget and monthly analysis.
units.Ranking Tiendas, Evolución por small mul: Store ranking, trends with small multiples, average ticket and KPI comparison between any pair of stores.
units.Navegación desde los rankings hacia el d: Navigation from the rankings down to the detail: category/product, margin %, product, profit and individual receipt.
units.Un treemap y un área mensual que aparece: A treemap and a monthly area chart that appear when you hover over a store or a category.
From the figure to the detail behind it.
units.Un responsable puede detectar una desvia: A manager can spot a variance in an indicator and start the analysis from there. From that point, they can dig into the report to find where the difference happens and end up looking at the detail needed to understand it.
units.El objetivo es que el dato agregado no s: The aim is for the aggregated figure to be the start of the analysis, not the end.
Two of the report’s thirteen pages.
units.Estas son dos ejemplos de cómo llevé el: These are two examples of how I took the model and the analysis logic into Power BI. Each page answers a different need, but they all start from the same data structure and share a common navigation logic. The aim was to avoid isolated dashboards and build a system where the different views complement each other.
units.Kosta Cálida, página Objetivos: portada: Kosta Cálida, Targets page: the report’s cover
units.Qué permite ver el sistema, en un caso c: What the system lets you see, in a specific case.
units.La utilidad del informe aparece cuando s: The report proves its worth when it’s used to answer specific questions. For example, if a KPI shows a change, I can start with the overall result, compare stores or categories and dig down until I find what’s causing the change.
units.El año cerró en <strong class=\"kc-tnum\: The year closed at €717,304 against a budget of €776,000: a variance of −€58,700 (−7.56%). The report’s cover breaks that figure down by store: Mahón, the network’s top seller (€277,000), was also the one dragging the variance down the most (−€47,700). Sant Francesc Xavier and Ibiza (town), with less volume, were the only two in positive territory (+€6,000 and +€4,600).
units.Un patrón parecido aparecía por categorí: A similar pattern appeared by category: Drinks and soft drinks led in both sales and margin (+37.58%), while Convenience and Express Store closed with a negative margin despite similar volume.
units.Para mí, esta es una de las partes más i: For me, this is one of the most interesting parts of Power BI: connecting different levels of information so users don’t have to start from scratch every time a new question comes up.
units.Modelo de datos, medidas, visualización: Data model, measures, visualisation and navigation.
units.Esquema en estrella y relaciones entre h: Star schema and relationships between facts and dimensions.
units.Trabajar en este proyecto me hizo presta: Working on this project made me pay much more attention to what happens before building a chart. When the data is well structured, the measures are organised and the model has a clear logic, it’s much easier to build a report that can grow without turning into a set of pieces that are hard to maintain.
units.También me ayudó a entender algo que con: It also helped me understand something I think matters in Power BI: a good dashboard doesn’t end when we find the right KPI. The interesting part starts when we can ask what lies behind that KPI and have a model ready to find the answer.
units.De datos sueltos en el TPV a un modelo q: From loose point-of-sale data to a model that holds up to any question.
units.He pasado de trabajar con datos de venta: I’ve gone from working with sales data that had no clear structure to building a Power BI model that connects the KPIs with the detail behind them. That journey — from data to model, from model to report and from report to question — is exactly the part of the project I most wanted to work on.
